text:
66세 여성 환자, necrotizing fasciitis로 인한 severe sepsis로 입원함.

BP 88/54 mmHg
HR 120 bpm
RR 28 breaths/min
BT 39.0°C
SpO2 90% on 15L O2 via non-rebreather mask

Severe pain 호소함.

Vancomycin 1g IV q12h 투여 중.

High-flow oxygen therapy 적용함.

Surgical debridement scheduled.

Foley 유지 중.

Positive balance 확인됨.

Drowsy 상태.

Infectious Disease와 Surgical teams notify함.
